dataset_lights_faithful.claim_boundary: Retains all five positive lights declared by ReplicaCAD. This is source-light-layout fidelity, not a claim that the open stage shell produces natural indoor illumination in UE.

room_local_review.claim_boundary: Visual-review profile only. It does not move or add lights: positive lights outside the imported stage-shell AABB are disabled. Source lights 0/1/2 use explicit backend-unit scales (UE 2.0, Habitat 4.0); these numbers are not treated as physically interchangeable units. The Habitat point-light realization remains a research comparison because the maintained Habitat review default is no_lights plus HBAO.
